corrections.record: Convolutional TM specialist: Histogram of Gradients
corrections.note: The paper never says the HoG specialist is convolutional or gives a window size; it only says it reuses the setup of github.com/hudara/cifar-10. 'Convolutional' is not reported for HoG.

notes: Single-model paper, 8 pages. Table 2 values all match the record. Statistic is 'accuracy after 100 epochs' (final epoch); number of runs not stated. Internal inconsistency: Sec. 4 p. 4 describes the CIFAR-100 Thresholding TM of Fig. 2 with 8 000 weighted clauses per class, T=2000, s=10.0, whereas Table 1 gives 16K clauses, T=4000 for CIFAR-100; the Color Thermometer TM of Fig. 4 (dataset not named) uses 8 000 clauses, T=6000, s=2.5, 4x4 window. Table 1/2 settings are used here. The composite normalizer alpha_t (Eq. 7) is the max-min class sum over 'the input set X', i.e. computed over the evaluated (test) inputs, unlabelled; labels are not used. Epoch-by-epoch curves (Figs. 5-6) and confidence-vs-accuracy curves (Figs. 2-4) are figures only and not extracted. Fashion-MNIST is grayscale, so 'per colour channel' presumably means a single channel there (not stated). Implementation library not named (cair code repo).
